title: 第27章下星核入手二人交心叙旧第27章上灵种苏醒获星核功法
slug: 欠我时间债天道也得跪着还
lines: 然后是第二样东西——那颗漆黑的水晶球。
苏余将手按在水晶球表面。
水晶球中的那颗光点在他触碰的瞬间猛然跳动，像是被唤醒的心脏。
球体表面浮现出一个清晰的画面——一个身穿青色道袍的中年男子，面容与苏玄有几分相似但更年轻更英武，盘膝坐在星图穹顶之下，手捏一个苏余从未见过的法印，眉心中悬浮着一颗与水晶球一模一样的黑色球体。
画面中的中年男子开口说话，声音沉稳如千年古钟——
“时族第十七代族长苏星河，于时族覆灭前三年，以毕生修为凝聚‘时之星核’一枚。
星核是时族至高秘法，非族长不可修习。
我将星核分为母体与子体——子体封印在这颗水晶球中，留给后世子孙参悟；母体封存在我自己的棺椁之中，等待真正的继承者。
融合子体后，你可靠星核将时痕凝聚为‘星点’，一击爆发所有星点，造成百倍于时痕总量的真实伤害。
星核每次充能需一百点时痕，充能完毕后可随时释放，不额外消耗时痕，也无使用次数限制。
星点凝聚的速度取决于时序锻体术的层数——锻体术每提升一层，星核可多凝聚一颗星点。
若有机缘寻得母体并完成融合，星核威力将再提升一个层次。”
苏余将手按在水晶球上开始融合。
水晶球在接触到他掌心星云印记的瞬间便化作一道黑光没入他眉心。
识海中时王碑旁边多了一颗缓缓旋转的黑色球体——时之星核。
星核目前只有一个微弱的黑色光点，那是第一颗星点的雏形。
随着时序锻体术层数提升，星点会逐渐增多，每一颗星点都是一次百倍时痕总量的真实伤害。
他默默对比了一下时劫和星核的区别——时劫是燃九息寿命召唤天劫，使用时金痕清零，天劫豁免失效，代价极高，是玉石俱焚的终极底牌。
而星核是以时痕充能，没有使用代价，没有使用次数限制。
虽然每次只能释放当前星点数量的百倍伤害，但星点可以持续积累、持续补充。
两者一为绝境杀器，一为常规战法，正好互补。
他回到主石室时，林霜正盘膝坐在篝火旁闭目调息。
她体内的灵力流转平稳而绵长，守宫蛊仍在安静沉睡，没有任何异常波动。
听到苏余的脚步声，她睁开眼。
七天不见，苏余的气息完全变了——之前像一把出鞘的刀，锋利但锋芒毕露，隔着老远就能感受到那股让人汗毛竖立的锐气；现在像一把收刀入鞘的刀，刀鞘就是那层覆盖在他身体表面的暗金色时痕膜。
刀还在，但外人看不到了。
所有的锋芒都被收敛在那层看似不起眼的薄膜之下，只有真正面对他的人才能感受到那股被压抑到极致后反而更加危险的压迫感。
“你练了家传的功法？”
林霜问。
“时序锻体术，时门的核心内功。
跟演武场的炼体拳是一套——拳法是外功，锻体术是内功。
内外兼修才能发挥全部威力。”
苏余在她对面坐下，从篝火旁拿起一块烤热的干粮啃了一口。
干粮硬得像木头，但在这风雪交加的雪原避难所里，一口热食就是最大的奢侈。
林霜没有再追问。
content_en:
Then came the second thing - the dark crystal ball.
Su Yu pressed his hand on the surface of the crystal ball.
The light spot in the crystal ball beat suddenly the moment he touched it, like an awakened heart.
A clear picture emerged on the surface of the sphere - a middle-aged man wearing a blue robe, his face somewhat similar to Su Xuan but younger and more heroic, sitting cross-legged under the dome of the star map, holding a seal that Su Yu had never seen before, and a black sphere exactly like the crystal ball suspended between his eyebrows.
The middle-aged man in the picture spoke, his voice as steady as a thousand-year-old bell——
"Su Xinghe, the seventeenth generation patriarch of the Shi Clan, spent his entire life cultivating himself to condense a 'Star Core of Time' three years before the demise of the Shi Clan.
The Star Core is the supreme secret method of the Time Clan and cannot be practiced except by the Clan Leader.
I divided the star core into a mother body and a child body - the child body is sealed in this crystal ball for future generations to understand; the mother body is sealed in my own coffin, waiting for the true successor.
After fusing the daughter body, you can rely on the star core to condense the time traces into 'star points', and explode all the star points in one blow, causing real damage that is a hundred times the total amount of time traces.
Each time the star core is charged, it requires one hundred time marks. It can be released at any time after charging, with no additional time marks consumed and no limit on the number of times it can be used.
The speed at which star points are condensed depends on the number of layers of the time-sequential physical training technique - for each level of physical training technique, the star core can condense one more star point.
If there is a chance to find the mother body and complete the fusion, the power of the star core will be increased to another level. "
Su Yu pressed his hand on the crystal ball and started fusion.
The moment the crystal ball came into contact with the nebula mark in his palm, it turned into a black light and sank into his eyebrows.
There is a slowly rotating black sphere next to the King of Time Monument in the Sea of ​​Consciousness - the Star Core of Time.
There is currently only a faint black light spot in the star core, which is the prototype of the first star point.
As the layers of the Time Sequential Forging Technique increase, the star points will gradually increase. Each star point is a true damage that is a hundred times the total amount of time traces.
He silently compared the difference between Time Tribulation and Star Core - Time Tribulation burns nine breaths of life to summon Heavenly Tribulation. When used, the golden traces are cleared and the Heavenly Tribulation immunity is invalid. The price is extremely high. It is the ultimate trump card that will destroy both jade and stone.
The star core is charged with time marks, there is no cost for use, and there is no limit on the number of times it can be used.
Although the damage can only be released one hundred times the current number of star points each time, the star points can be continuously accumulated and replenished.
One is a desperate weapon, the other is a conventional combat method, which complement each other perfectly.
When he returned to the main stone room, Lin Shuang was sitting cross-legged by the bonfire, closing his eyes and regulating his breath.
The spiritual power in her body flows steadily and continuously, and the palace guard Gu is still sleeping quietly without any abnormal fluctuations.
Hearing Su Yu's footsteps, she opened her eyes.
After not seeing each other for seven days, Su Yu's aura had completely changed - before it was like an unsheathed knife, sharp but revealing, and the sharpness that made people's hair stand on end could be felt from a long distance away; now it was like a knife being sheathed, and the sheath was the dark golden time-marked film covering the surface of his body.
The knife is still there, but outsiders can't see it.
All the sharp edges are restrained under that seemingly inconspicuous film. Only those who really face him can feel the oppressive feeling that is suppressed to the extreme and becomes more dangerous.
"Have you practiced the martial arts passed down from your family?"
Lin Shuang asked.
"Time Sequence Exercise, the core internal skill of Shimen.
It is the same as the physical training boxing in the martial arts field - the boxing technique is external strength, and the physical training technique is internal strength.
Only by practicing internally and externally can the full power be exerted. "
Su Yu sat down opposite her, picked up a piece of hot dry food from the campfire and took a bite.
The dry food was as hard as wood, but in this windy and snowy snowfield shelter, a bite of hot food was the greatest luxury.
Lin Shuang didn't ask any more questions.
title_en: Chapter 27: The lower star core is obtained. The two have a heart-to-heart talk and reminisce about the past. Chapter 27: The upper spirit species awakens and obtains the star core technique.
